scope: Read-only production-dist Chromium H1 probe; only this formal JSON evidence persists

hypotheses.claim: Eager Response(decompressed).arrayBuffer() fails while chunk-discarding DecompressionStream consumption can pass 1 GiB with much lower memory.
DecompressionStream itself fails on this 2,898,432,000-byte gzip output even when chunks are not retained.
The same-origin compressed response is truncated or carries incompatible headers/bytes.

environment.profileIsolation: Separate empty run-owned profile directory for each case; cases run sequentially

asset.validationMethod: Browser response status/headers plus in-page TransformStream compressed-byte count; hash was not recomputed

comparison.reason: Streaming consumed the complete 2,898,432,000-byte output and all 643,211,474 compressed response bytes, while the independent eager arrayBuffer path rejected with TypeError: Failed to fetch. Eager allocation pressure appeared in Chromium process memory rather than performance.memory: streaming peak working set was 21.8% of eager (78.2% lower).
comparison.jsHeapInterpretation: performance.memory did not account for the eager ArrayBuffer/native buffering pressure; the browser process tree working set and private memory captured it.
